title: Macy's Holiday Lane Silver Snowflake Watch - New in Box
descriptionText:
Brand new, never worn. Comes in original Macy’s Holiday Lane gift box — perfect for the holiday season!
🌟 Description:
Celebrate the winter season in style with this elegant Macy’s Holiday Lane women’s watch.
Featuring a beautiful snowflake design on the dial, this timepiece captures the festive spirit while maintaining a timeless, classy look.
🕒 Features:
Brand: Macy’s Holiday Lane
Model: Snowflake Dial Holiday Watch
Dial Color: White with black snowflake design
Case Material: Metal bezel
Back Material: Stainless steel back (engraved “STAINLESS STEEL BACK / METAL BEZEL”)
Band Style: Silver-tone bangle bracelet
Display Type: Analog
Movement: Quartz
Packaging: Original Macy’s Holiday Lane red-and-gold box
Condition: New (unused, kept in packaging)
🎁 Perfect For:
Holiday gift giving
Winter accessories
Collectors of seasonal fashion watches
